title: Antares raises $470M to build nuclear reactors for the US military
slides: What if a startup could power a US base?
Antares just raised $470M from private backers.
Its reactors will be mobile, not just stationary.
Militaries can now deploy power to remote zones.
Test if your site could host a microreactor.
thread_text:
1. What if a startup could power a US base?

Antares just raised $470M from private backers to build mobile nuclear reactors.

2. Mobility is the game-changer

These reactors aren't stuck in one place—they can be trucked to any location.

3. Militaries can now deploy power to remote zones

No need for vulnerable fuel convoys; just drop a microreactor on-site.

4. Site readiness matters

Before deployment, the ground must pass a radiological and structural test.

5. Can your site host a microreactor?

Look up your local geological survey data today. If the ground is stable, that's step one.

instagram.caption:
A startup just raised $470 million to put nuclear reactors on trucks for the US military. ⚛️

These microreactors are designed to be mobile—trucked to any remote base instead of staying fixed in one spot. No more vulnerable fuel convoys: just drop a reactor on-site for immediate power.

Before deployment, every site must pass a radiological and structural ground test. If you manage military or remote infrastructure, that test is your new gatekeeper.

Could your location pass the ground stability check today? 🚛
